campaign.name: Perfumarte AI Art Direction
campaign.objective: Generate two visually coherent premium campaign images for Bianche Princess (GTB), translating its warm gourmand sweetness into a tactile, elegant and feminine visual world.

visual_relationship.rule: Both images represent the same fragrance identity through a warm gourmand composition built from caramel, coumarin, honey, vanilla and white musk.
consistency: same caramel-amber, cream and ivory color family
same warm, sophisticated and enveloping emotional atmosphere

physical_scale_system.scale_reference: Use the perfume bottle as the physical scale reference for the entire scene.
physical_scale_system.element_scale_rule: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.relative_scale: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.artistic_scale_override: Do not create abundance by artificially enlarging ingredients.

fragrance_data.name: Bianche Princess (GTB)
fragrance_data.description:
Bianche Princess (GTB): un perfume nicho gourmand femenino, dulce y sofisticado

Bianche Princess (GTB) es un perfume nicho gourmand femenino que celebra la dulzura, la calidez y la elegancia en una fragancia envolvente y adictiva. Diseñado para mujeres que disfrutan de aromas golosos pero refinados, combina notas dulces con un fondo suave y elegante que lo hace perfecto para el día a día o momentos especiales.

Este perfume nicho gourmand femenino destaca por su carácter cálido, cremoso y muy femenino, dejando una estela inolvidable.

 

 

¿A qué huele Bianche Princess (GTB)?

Bianche Princess (GTB) es un perfume nicho gourmand femenino donde el caramelo, la miel, la cumarina, la vainilla y el almizcle blanco crean una fragancia dulce, cálida y sofisticada.

Una salida dulce y golosa

La fragancia se abre con caramelo, ofreciendo un inicio adictivo, alegre y envolvente que conquista desde el primer instante.

Un corazón cálido y elegante

La cumarina y la miel aportan una faceta suave, dulce y sofisticada que equilibra perfectamente el carácter gourmand.

Un fondo cremoso y duradero

La vainilla y el almizcle blanco crean una base envolvente, delicada y muy femenina que deja una estela suave, elegante y persistente.

olfactive_translation.principle: Translate the fragrance into a refined visual story of warm caramelized sweetness, honeyed luminosity, creamy vanilla and a soft white musk aura rather than depicting every note literally or uniformly.
selection_rules: Select only the most visually expressive olfactive elements.
Prioritize elements that communicate the fragrance identity.
Do not visually represent every note by default.
Atmospheric notes may be represented through color, texture, material, smoke, light or environment.
Never introduce ingredients that are not supported by fragrance_data.notes.
The selected visual elements must work coherently across both campaign images.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Sweet gourmand opening and immediate signature.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several translucent amber caramel shards, small glossy caramel ribbons and a few realistic hardened caramel pieces with irregular handmade edges.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Caramel is the clearest visual symbol of the fragrance's addictive gourmand character.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A concentrated amber cluster beside and slightly behind the bottle, with a few pieces in the foreground and controlled glossy highlights.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A warm, viscous caramel structure flows in physically plausible suspended folds from the foreground toward the bottle sides and into the background, without forming a geometric ring or covering the bottle.
selected_visual_notes.physical_presence: Primary visual ingredient with strong tactile and color presence.
selected_visual_notes.composition_role: Creates the warm amber anchor, directional flow and richest material contrast around the product.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Soft hay-like, powdery and elegant heart facet.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Fine pale-golden coumarin crystals and delicate dry powder settled in small realistic deposits, interpreted as the note's material facet rather than as an invented botanical ingredient.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Its crystalline, powdery appearance communicates the refined warmth and softness of coumarin without introducing unsupported ingredients.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Moderate amounts placed in narrow deposits around the caramel, catching soft light and adding dry powdery texture.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Small suspended crystalline veils and powder traces connect caramel masses near the bottle, with subtle swirling motion and no chaotic particle cloud.
selected_visual_notes.physical_presence: Secondary but clearly legible textural accent.
selected_visual_notes.composition_role: Balances the glossy caramel with a dry, powdery surface language and bridges the top and heart.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Luminous, warm and enveloping heart sweetness.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Compact sections of real honeycomb, a few honey-filled cells and slow amber honey threads with natural viscosity.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Honeycomb and honey offer a physically recognizable expression of warm, golden sweetness and abundance.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: One substantial honeycomb grouping in the midground, supported by smaller overlapping sections and restrained honey glints.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Unequal honeycomb masses sit close to both bottle sides, while honey threads stretch naturally between foreground and background as suspended viscous strands.
selected_visual_notes.physical_presence: Major supporting ingredient with strong structural and luminous presence.
selected_visual_notes.composition_role: Builds the main clustered architecture and introduces organic cell texture against the smooth bottle.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Creamy, sweet and persistent gourmand base.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Multiple slender vanilla pods, some whole and some naturally split, with visible dark seeds and supple brown texture.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Vanilla pods provide an elegant, tactile and physically coherent expression of the creamy gourmand base.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Several pods form a low, refined cluster on the surface, with split pods adding detail without competing with the label.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Curved vanilla pods create organic framing along the lower sides and behind the bottle, maintaining natural botanical behavior rather than a circular arrangement.
selected_visual_notes.physical_presence: Strong secondary anchor with elongated tactile forms.
selected_visual_notes.composition_role: Adds directional curves, dark tonal contrast and a clear connection to the creamy base.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Soft, clean, diffusive and feminine drydown.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: A pearlescent white musk atmosphere expressed through translucent creamy vapor, soft white microfibers and luminous diffused haze, without inventing a literal solid ingredient.
selected_visual_notes.reason: White musk is atmospheric rather than botanically literal; light, vapor and soft fiber-like texture communicate its clean enveloping quality.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A restrained ivory haze behind the bottle and along the background, leaving the label crisp and the typography legible.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A controlled pearly vapor envelope moves behind and around the ingredient clusters, integrated with the caramel and honey atmosphere while preserving strong product contrast.
selected_visual_notes.physical_presence: Low physical density but essential atmospheric presence.
selected_visual_notes.composition_role: Unifies the scene, softens transitions and provides the creamy white luminosity implied by the fragrance name.

shared_visual_identity.concept: La dulzura dorada de una princesa blanca: un universo gourmand de caramelo, miel y vainilla envuelto en una atmósfera cremosa de almizcle blanco.
shared_visual_identity.emotional_goal: Communicate irresistible sweetness refined by softness, elegance and a clean creamy finish.
shared_visual_identity.environmental_identity: A warm ivory studio environment with honeyed reflected light, creamy atmospheric depth and a tactile confectionery-luxury still-life language.

editorial_still_life.concept: The bottle stands vertically on a warm matte ivory stone surface, surrounded by an abundant but controlled arrangement of caramel, honeycomb, coumarin crystals and vanilla pods, with a soft white musk haze creating a luxurious creamy backdrop.

environment.description: A refined studio set built around a matte warm-cream stone slab. The bottle is completely vertical and stable at the centre-right of the hero area, supported directly by the surface. Honeycomb and caramel form a rich low arrangement around it, while vanilla pods add restrained organic lines. A softly graduated ivory background carries a subtle pearlescent musk haze.
environment.background_rule: The background remains warm ivory and softly atmospheric, with enough clean negative space on the upper-left side for Spanish typography without competing with the bottle or ingredients.

visual_elements: fully visible perfume bottle standing vertically
multiple realistic caramel shards and small glossy caramel pieces
one substantial honeycomb cluster with visible honey-filled cells
several whole and split vanilla pods
small deposits of pale-golden coumarin crystals

composition.negative_space: generous controlled negative space in the upper-left and around the typography, with denser material grouping concentrated low and to the sides of the bottle
composition.depth: clear foreground, midground and background separation with realistic focus falloff
composition.bottle_priority: highest; the bottle remains the sharpest, brightest and most legible object

lighting.direction: large soft key light from upper left with a gentle warm fill from front right and controlled golden bounce from the honeycomb
lighting.contrast: moderate contrast with luminous amber highlights and soft shadows

elements: NOTAS DE FONDO · ALMIZCLE BLANCO · VAINILLA

style.primary: elegant editorial serif in warm dark brown or muted caramel
style.secondary: refined minimalist sans-serif in soft taupe
style.hierarchy: clear and sophisticated, with the perfume name dominant and note information understated

rules: Typography must never cover the perfume bottle.
Text must remain legible against the ivory background.
Place typography only in the generous upper-left negative space.
Do not overload the image with text.
Keep all text visually subordinate to the bottle.

immersive_surreal.concept: A suspended bottle enters a compact floating confectionery atmosphere where caramel and honey form a warm material current, vanilla pods curve naturally through the space, coumarin crystals drift lightly and white musk vapor creates a luminous creamy depth.

environment.description: The perfume bottle floats near the visual centre on the main compositional axis, tilted subtly 8 degrees with the cap displaced slightly left and the base slightly right. It remains fully visible, sharply focused and clearly separated by controlled contrast while compact ingredient masses press close to its sides and continue behind its silhouette.

visual_elements: single fully visible suspended perfume bottle with fixed leftward cap tilt
realistic caramel folds and irregular hardened caramel pieces
unequal honeycomb clusters with visible honey
natural vanilla pods, whole and split
small coumarin crystal deposits and drifting powder traces
pearly white musk vapor and soft ivory haze
cropped foreground caramel and vanilla masses

composition.element_density: high locally clustered with clear hierarchy
composition.depth: strong foreground, midground and background photographic depth with medium-shallow focus
composition.bottle_priority: highest; fully visible through contrast, lighting and focus, with ingredients close to its sides and behind its silhouette
composition.negative_space: small irregular breathing areas between compact material masses; no empty halo around the bottle
composition.enveloping_structure: A dominant suspended caramel-and-honey material current begins as softly defocused amber caramel masses in the lower foreground, rises unevenly beside the bottle through honeycomb clusters and viscous honey threads, then dissolves into warm amber haze behind the bottle. Vanilla pods intersect this current as natural curved botanical forms, while a thin pearlescent white musk vapor connects the foreground, the close bottle space and the background without becoming a geometric ring.
primary_clusters: A heavier lower-left cluster of cropped caramel pieces, one honeycomb section and several vanilla pods close to the bottle, with amber weight and shallow focus; it connects upward through honey threads.

A tighter upper-right cluster of honeycomb fragments, caramel folds and sparse coumarin crystals positioned near the bottle's shoulder but behind its silhouette, lighter and more luminous than the left cluster.
A smaller lower-right vanilla-and-coumarin cluster partly veiled by white musk vapor, providing asymmetrical balance and a visible connection to the background current.
composition.foreground_plan: Place realistic-scale caramel fragments, a partial honeycomb edge and one or two vanilla pods very close to the camera at the lower corners and lateral edges. They are partially cropped, overlapping and softly defocused, with glossy amber highlights and tactile wax texture. They frame the scene without entering the bottle silhouette.
composition.midground_plan: Concentrate the main honeycomb, caramel and vanilla groupings within close lateral proximity to the suspended bottle. Keep the bottle fully visible and in sharp focus. Allow honey threads and a few coumarin crystals to pass behind the bottle's silhouette, while caramel folds sit beside it and never cover the cap, label or glass edges.
composition.background_plan: Continue the caramel-and-honey material current behind the bottle into a warm amber-to-ivory atmospheric background. Extend partial honeycomb textures, softened vanilla lines and diffused coumarin particles toward the image edges, with pearly white musk vapor providing layered depth rather than empty space.
composition.overlap_plan: Vanilla pods overlap the lower edges of caramel masses; honeycomb partially overlaps caramel in the lateral clusters; viscous honey passes behind the bottle and between ingredient groups. Coumarin crystals rest on caramel and honeycomb surfaces and drift lightly in open gaps. All ingredients remain behind or beside the product, never over the cap, label or central glass body.
composition.negative_space_plan: Use small irregular wedges of warm ivory atmosphere between the unequal clusters, especially near the upper-left and lower-right. Maintain breathing gaps for silhouette clarity but never create a wide empty halo around the bottle.

lighting.direction: warm directional key from upper left, narrow rim light from behind and subtle creamy fill from lower front
lighting.contrast: controlled dramatic contrast, with bright edge separation on the bottle and saturated amber highlights in the ingredient masses

negative_constraints: no typography in the immersive surreal image
no surreal bottle tilt in the opposite direction
no wide empty halo around the surreal bottle
